title: koeleria littoralis
intro: Koeleria littoralis, commonly known as Salt Grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been found to have several health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health due to its high content of flavonoids and phenolic acids. The therapeutic actions of Koeleria littoralis include its potential to act as an antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory agent, which can help to protect against cell damage and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Koeleria littoralis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
